title: design-extract takes a URL, crawls the live DOM, and reverse-engineers the entire design language
description:
design-extract takes a URL, crawls the live DOM, and reverse-engineers the entire design language. Colors, fonts, grid patterns, hover transitions, responsive breakpoints. Outputs a Tailwind config, CSS variables, a shadcn/ui theme, and Figma variables. Install the output as a Claude Code skill, type /extract-design stripe.com, and your agent builds a landing page matching that exact design system first try.

https://github.com/Manavarya09/design-extract

#github #opensource
